items.title: Union Pacific (UNP) Reported a $91M Fuel Surcharge Surplus. Could That Hurt its Norfolk Southern Deal?
items.summary: Union Pacific Corporation (NYSE:UNP) reported $91.1 million more in fuel-surcharge revenue than in fuel cost during the second quarter, according to its Surface Transportation Board filing. Management separately attributed $0.14 of EPS, approximately $83.2 million using diluted weighted-average shares, to the net difference between fuel expense and surcharge revenue. items.title: All Aboard: STB Resumes Union Pacific-Norfolk Southern Merger Review
items.summary: The Surface Transportation Board said supplemental information from the railroads was sufficient to restart its review, with a final decision not expected until after May 2027.
